final: SELECT cs.raceId, AVG(cs.points) AS avg_points, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins, AVG(cs.wins) - (SELECT AVG(race_avg_wins) FROM (SELECT raceId, AVG(wins) AS race_avg_wins FROM constructorStandings WHERE points > 6.0 GROUP BY raceId)) AS difference FROM constructorStandings cs WHERE cs.points > 6.0 GROUP BY cs.raceId ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
